plan: Hold all accepted state in a single public `session` dict with exactly the four contract keys, reset from one initial template so `begin` and `abandon` produce identical clean states.
Route `handle(action)` through a dispatch table keyed by `type`; non-dict actions, missing/unknown types, and wrong-typed fields short-circuit to an error screen before any mutation.
Each handler validates preconditions and payload fully, then mutates the session and returns a screen; errors are built from the unchanged session so accepted data is never corrupted.

Centralize screen construction in one builder that derives choices solely from the prompt text, guaranteeing appointment choices appear exactly when the prompt is `Choose appointment` and are in input order.

Compute the post-correction prompt from session state (unconfirmed contact -> `Confirm contact`, no appointment -> `Choose appointment`, else `Review and complete`); fixed prompts for begin/choice/complete/abandon come straight from the contract.

Inject `action_source` and `screen_sink` as constructor collaborators; `run_once()` raises RuntimeError before touching either if one is missing, otherwise reads one action, handles it, displays the resulting screen once, and returns that same object, so unittest fakes need only `read_action()` and `display()`.
mechanisms: single canonical session dictionary reset from an initial template
type-keyed dispatch table for structured actions
validate-then-mutate handlers with non-raising Error: screens
centralized screen builder enforcing the choices/prompt invariant
state-derived next-prompt computation for corrections and errors
constructor-injected action source and screen sink for test doubles
